name: @astragate-community/middleware-system-prompt
description: New API's system_prompt (系统提示词) as magpie gateway middleware: give agents' requests a system prompt of yours, in each API's own place for it

options.system_prompt: Reply in the language the user writes in.

summary.en: Add your own system prompt to every request, or only some agents' or models', in each API's own place.
summary.zh: 给每个请求（或指定 agent、模型）加上自己的系统提示词，放在各 API 自己的位置。
